tasks.short: Inspect inventory and identify replenishment needs.

steps.what: Count inventory and examine merchandise condition and shelf gaps.
Compare observations with stock records and flag items for replenishment.

tasks.design: Test native count-entry and replenishment flags in {OPS_SYSTEM}. Prefill stock records after an item scan, compare confirmed counts with thresholds and leave damaged-stock interpretation and replenishment exceptions with the stocker.
tasks.previous_blocker: Physical observations may need separate item lookup before comparison.
tasks.enabler_now: Native scanner forms can join count entry with existing stock thresholds.
tasks.still_hard: Hidden stock, damaged goods and wrong locations require physical inspection.
tasks.human_edge: Notice damaged packaging and explain gaps that the ledger cannot show.

ambition.what: Check replenishment exceptions for the fastest-selling shelf before peak trading.

tasks.altitude: Less record lookup, with the same authority to flag rather than place orders.

reach.learn: Stock movements, lead times and unit conversions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: scanner count forms and threshold comparisons can reduce lookup while leaving physical inventory checks intact.

assumptions: Boundary is a stock check through a replenishment flag, excluding purchasing and physical refill. The proposed 75/25 split requires observation before adoption.

Stock controller supplies item_id, location, unit, book_quantity and reorder_threshold in {OPS_SYSTEM}; stocker supplies observed_quantity and condition_code. Missing barcodes or thresholds retain manual identification and planner referral.
Test native configuration first. No camera counting or worker productivity score is proposed; national employee consultation and access checks are included.
unknowns: Existing scan coverage and threshold quality.
research_questions: Does joined count entry reduce lookup without hiding damaged stock?

already_counted.description: Review count differences and replenishment flags.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=90 gross=10 net=9 after 1 upkeep. Low: many unreadable labels; high: reliable item records. All physical inspection remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Answer merchandise questions and advise customers.

steps.what: Ask customers about their needs and clarify merchandise questions.
Look up merchandise specifications, stock and location.
Explain suitable merchandise choices and refer specialist questions.

tasks.design: Expose current product facts in a native {OPS_SYSTEM} item view with links to approved {DOCS} guidance. The stocker searches by item or category, then gives advice personally; no generated suitability claim is needed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specifications and stock locations can require separate lookups.
tasks.enabler_now: Configurable item views can place those facts together.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding intended use and knowing when specialist advice is needed.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt explanations to the customer and avoid unsuitable recommendations.

ambition.what: Help customers unfamiliar with product terminology find the right aisle and specialist.

tasks.altitude: Fewer searches; no change in product-advice authority.

reach.task: Compare two merchandise options for a customer.
reach.learn: Product suitability limits and comparison questions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked catalogue and stock views support factual lookup without replacing human advice.

assumptions: Boundary covers stocker conversations, not checkout or specialist consultation. Conversation time remains unchanged.

Merchandising supplies item_id, description, specifications, usage_limits and source_revision; inventory staff supply quantity, location and timestamp. Missing facts require a manual document lookup or specialist referral.
Native search and item-view configuration are tested before custom code; no new customer profiling is required.
unknowns: Catalogue completeness and current lookup effort.
research_questions: Can staff retrieve authoritative facts without overstating suitability?

incremental.description: Report missing or inconsistent item facts.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=92 gross=8 net=7 after 1 upkeep. Low: facts already easy to find; high: fragmented stock and specification screens. Listening and advice unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Receive and count stock, then record quantities.

steps.what: Receive stock items, count units and inspect delivery discrepancies.
Record counted stock and discrepancy reasons against the expected delivery.

tasks.design: Test the {OPS_SYSTEM} native receiving scanner so item identification preloads expected delivery lines. The stocker enters the actual count, checks units and records shortages or damage; the workflow never substitutes ordered quantity for observed quantity.
tasks.previous_blocker: Count results can be retyped after physical receiving.
tasks.enabler_now: Barcode receiving forms can write confirmed observations directly to stock records.
tasks.still_hard: Mixed cartons, unit mismatches and damaged labels still need checking.
tasks.human_edge: Establish what physically arrived rather than trust the shipping notice.
tasks.altitude: Less desk entry after receiving; adjustment authority stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: scanner receiving can remove repeated count entry; it does not eliminate counting.

assumptions: Boundary includes counting and goods-receipt entry, excluding unloading and subsequent putaway. Counting has no claimed saving.

Purchasing supplies delivery_id, order_line, item_id, expected_quantity and unit; stocker produces actual_quantity, location and discrepancy_code. Unreadable labels use manual item selection and count entry, not guessed extraction.
Native receiving configuration first. Scanner access and national employee consultation are included; records serve receipt traceability rather than individual rankings.
unknowns: Existing scanner use and receiving unit mismatches.
research_questions: Does direct entry reduce transcription errors without accepting expected quantities blindly?

already_counted.description: Check scanned identity, units and receipt entry.

incremental.description: Report scanner and item mapping defects.
Maintain receiving mappings and device access.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=86 gross=14 net=13 after 1 upkeep. Low: many manual item lookups; high: clean labels and compatible units. Physical receiving and counting unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Unload, unpack and issue sales-floor merchandise.

steps.what: Receive, unload and open merchandise cartons at the delivery area.
Move and issue the unpacked merchandise to the sales floor.

tasks.design: Keep physical unloading and merchandise issue manual. Check existing {OPS_SYSTEM} delivery instructions for access or destination problems, but make no software labour-saving claim for this physical task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work requires lifting, opening and moving varied goods.
tasks.enabler_now: No software change removes these physical actions.
tasks.still_hard: Unsafe loads, damaged cartons and constrained unloading space.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize unstable loads and adapt handling safely.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in the stocker week or decision rights.

reach.task: Prepare a safe route for incoming goods.
reach.learn: Load stability, handling aids and pedestrian separation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: generic software cannot perform physical unloading or unpacking; no robotic installation is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary covers physical handling only. Stock counting and receipt records belong to the separate receiving task and are not duplicated.

Receiving staff provide carton identification and sales-floor destination on existing delivery instructions; missing labels require manual identification before movement. No new structured interface or extraction is required.
Check existing native delivery instructions before considering code. Zero upkeep is justified because no new system, automation or transferred work is introduced.
unknowns: Handling equipment, delivery layout and physical constraints.
research_questions: Would a separate handling-equipment change improve safety or effort?

incremental.description: No new system or ongoing upkeep is introduced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 upkeep=0 net=0. Both ordinary cartons and awkward mixed loads retain all physical handling time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Target record entry and factual lookup while preserving physical handling and customer attention.
role.ambitious_version: A stocker who identifies recurrent stock problems and helps customers while keeping physical counts trustworthy.
